Name: Aristarchus
Summary: Aristarchus was a Macedonian of Thessalonica who travelled with Paul, was seized in the Ephesian riot, accompanied Paul to Jerusalem and later to Rome, and shared his imprisonment there.
KeyStory: Aristarchus was dragged into the Ephesian theatre, sailed with Paul to Rome, and shared his prison.
LifeLesson: Aristarchus stayed from riot to prison. Faithful companions do not leave when the journey turns hard.
